mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months, it signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-side expansion (INDPRO growth rate above 0.5% monthly), manufacturing output increases boost corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion that increases corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12mo change > 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion (HOUST growth rate above 0.3% monthly), housing market recovery boosts consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST growth exceeds 0.3% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
